notes.title: Polish language added!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5912368/ef68347442008309f5d03d5aecd68d84b86a86b0.jpg[/img]

Hello friends!

Today we have exciting news, mainly for our Polish pilots - Parkan II now supports Polish language! You can now enjoy your adventure across universe with Polish audio and subtitles and that means it's great opportunity to get back into action!

[list]
[*]Added Polish language subtitles 
[*]Added Polish language full audio
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/289400/Parkan_2/
